description: Prepare the registration of a free .cell name for a person: returns a link that opens it on cellula.id, where they sign with their own wallet. Nothing is registered or paid by this tool. With invited_by (a registered .cell name), the link carries that name's invitation: a tenth of the fee goes to that name's owner in the same transaction, and the person pays the same as without it. Says the yearly fee and, when invited, the inviter's share.

invited_by.description: A registered .cell name whose owner invites this registration

name.description: The name to register, with or without .cell

network.description: Which Nervos network to read. Defaults to mainnet.

name: cell_name_registration_link
title: A link to register a free .cell name
